title: Kathmandu Valley Mountain Biking
shortDescription: A single-day guided mountain bike ride through the Kathmandu Valley.
fullDescription: Experience the thrill of mountain biking around the Kathmandu Valley in a single day. This guided ride takes you through ancient villages, terraced fields, pine forests, and hilltop viewpoints with panoramic views of the Himalayas.
highlights: Suitable for beginners and intermediate riders
Quality mountain bike and safety gear provided

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley Bike Ride
itinerary.description: Pick up from your hotel, transfer to the trailhead, and enjoy a guided full-day mountain bike ride through the valley.

inclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Kathmandu
Basic repair kit and first aid

faqs.question: Do I need to be an experienced rider?
faqs.answer: No, this day trip is suitable for beginners with basic fitness and confidence on a bike.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Comfortable cycling clothes, sunglasses, sunscreen, and a small backpack. We provide the bike and helmet.

faqs.question: What is the best season for this ride?
faqs.answer: The best seasons are autumn (September to November) and spring (March to May) with clear skies and pleasant temperatures.

faqs.question: What is included in the price?
faqs.answer: The price includes the mountain bike, helmet, guide, support vehicle, meals, and accommodation as per the itinerary.

faqs.question: Do I need to bring my own biking gear?
faqs.answer: Bikes and helmets are provided. You should bring your own cycling clothes, gloves, and sunglasses for comfort.

faqs.question: Do I need travel insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, travel insurance covering adventure activities and emergency evacuation is strongly recommended.

faqs.question: How do we handle altitude on longer rides?
faqs.answer: We include acclimatization days and our guides monitor everyone closely. The itinerary is designed for a safe gradual ascent.

faqs.question: What type of accommodation is provided?
faqs.answer: Comfortable lodges and tea houses along the route, with twin-sharing rooms and locally-sourced meals.

faqs.question: How should I prepare physically?
faqs.answer: We recommend regular cycling, cardio, and leg strengthening exercises for at least 2-3 months before the trip.

faqs.question: What happens in case of bike breakdown?
faqs.answer: Our support vehicle carries spare parts and a mechanic. We can also swap bikes if needed to keep the trip running smoothly.

title: Annapurna Circuit Mountain Biking
shortDescription: Ride one of the world's classic mountain bike routes through the Annapurna Circuit.
fullDescription: Ride one of the world's classic mountain bike routes. The Annapurna Circuit combines challenging high-altitude passes, dramatic descents, subtropical valleys, and traditional mountain villages with stunning views of Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges.
highlights: Cross Thorong La Pass (5,416 m) on two wheels
Epic downhill sections from Muktinath to Tatopani
Diverse landscapes from jungle to alpine desert

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Besisahar
itinerary.description: Drive from Kathmandu to Besisahar, the starting point of the Annapurna Circuit.

itinerary.title: Besisahar to Bahundanda
itinerary.description: Begin biking through terraced hills and villages.

itinerary.title: Bahundanda to Chamje
itinerary.description: Ride through Marsyangdi Valley gorges.

itinerary.title: Chamje to Bagarchhap
itinerary.description: Climb through forests to Bagarchhap.

itinerary.title: Bagarchhap to Chame
itinerary.description: Ride to the district headquarters of Manang.

itinerary.title: Chame to Pisang
itinerary.description: Scenic ride with Annapurna II views.

itinerary.title: Pisang to Manang
itinerary.description: Tackle the upper Pisang route for spectacular views.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Manang
itinerary.description: Rest day with optional hike to Ice Lake or Gangapurna viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Manang to Thorong Phedi
itinerary.description: Ride to the base of Thorong La Pass.

itinerary.title: Cross Thorong La to Muktinath
itinerary.description: Early morning push to Thorong La, then long descent to Muktinath.

itinerary.title: Muktinath to Tatopani
itinerary.description: Epic downhill ride through Jomsom and Marpha.

itinerary.title: Tatopani to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Final ride to Beni and drive to Pokhara.

inclusions: All accommodation and meals during the ride
Support vehicle for luggage and emergencies

faqs.question: How difficult is this ride?
faqs.answer: This is a challenging ride due to high altitude and long days. Good fitness and off-road biking experience are recommended.

faqs.question: What happens if I cannot cross Thorong La?
faqs.answer: Our support vehicle and guide will assist with alternative arrangements for your safety.

faqs.question: What is the best season for this ride?
faqs.answer: The best seasons are autumn (September to November) and spring (March to May) with clear skies and pleasant temperatures.

faqs.question: Do I need travel insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes, travel insurance covering adventure activities and emergency evacuation is strongly recommended.

faqs.answer: We include acclimatization days and our guides monitor everyone closely. The itinerary is designed for a safe gradual ascent.

title: Mustang Mountain Biking Adventure
shortDescription: Ride through the mystical Upper Mustang region and the walled city of Lo Manthang.
fullDescription: Explore the mystical Upper Mustang region on two wheels. This adventure takes you through the rain shadow of the Himalayas, ancient Tibetan-influenced villages, dramatic canyons, and the walled city of Lo Manthang.
highlights: Ride through the forbidden kingdom of Mustang
Explore the ancient walled city of Lo Manthang
Dramatic desert landscapes and deep gorges

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Drive or fly from Kathmandu to Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Pokhara to Jomsom
itinerary.description: Take a morning flight to Jomsom and start biking to Kagbeni.

itinerary.title: Kagbeni to Chele
itinerary.description: Enter Upper Mustang and ride along the Kali Gandaki river.

itinerary.title: Chele to Syangboche
itinerary.description: Climb through rocky terrain and cross several passes.

itinerary.title: Syangboche to Ghami
itinerary.description: Ride past ancient chortens and the longest mani wall in Mustang.

itinerary.title: Ghami to Tsarang
itinerary.description: Cross Tsarang La and explore Tsarang village and monastery.

itinerary.title: Tsarang to Lo Manthang
itinerary.description: Ride to the walled capital of Upper Mustang.

itinerary.title: Explore Lo Manthang
itinerary.description: Rest day to visit monasteries, caves, and the royal palace.

itinerary.title: Lo Manthang to Jomsom
itinerary.description: Return ride via a different route to Jomsom.

itinerary.title: Jomsom to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Pokhara. Trip concludes.

inclusions: All accommodation and meals during the ride
Upper Mustang special permit and ACAP permit

faqs.question: Do I need a special permit for Mustang?
faqs.answer: Yes, Upper Mustang requires a special restricted area permit, which we arrange for you.

faqs.question: Is this ride mostly off-road?
faqs.answer: Yes, Mustang trails are mostly off-road with rocky and sandy sections. Prior mountain biking experience is recommended.
